site_title.description: Global site title used as the default SEO title across public pages.

site_description.description: Global meta description for the homepage and pages without a custom description.

default_keywords.description: Comma-separated default keywords applied across public pages.

social_image_url.description: Default Open Graph / Twitter card image URL.

google_verification.description: Google Search Console verification content value (without the meta tag wrapper).

bing_verification.description: Bing Webmaster Tools verification content value.

default_robots.description: Default robots meta directive for indexable public pages.

index_repeaters.description: Whether public repeater pages are indexable by search engines.

index_clubs.description: Whether public club pages are indexable by search engines.

index_nets.description: Whether public net pages are indexable by search engines.

index_events.description: Whether public event pages are indexable by search engines.

index_forum.description: Whether forum pages are indexable by search engines.

index_profiles.description: Whether public member profile pages are indexable. Defaults to off for privacy.

enable_structured_data.description: Inject Schema.org JSON-LD structured data on public pages.

enable_breadcrumbs.description: Display breadcrumb navigation with BreadcrumbList schema on public pages.

enable_sitemap.description: Generate and serve the dynamic XML sitemap.

description.description: Optional free-form note describing this SEO settings record.
